name: 66502 · Manhattan, KS
findings: ZIP 66502 (Manhattan) has 251 nonprofit organizations. 130 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66502 (Manhattan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
